generation_contract.positive_template: One {material} {form_factor} {object_type} standing on a {stand_type}, a household {category}: one large 16:9 flat-screen television, far wider than tall, with a blank matte dark screen. One narrow perforated speaker grille spans the full lower bezel. Excluding the feet, the display is a uniformly thin slab less than one twelfth of the screen width. Its rear is one plain shallow panel without cables, ports, brackets, vents, recesses, protrusions, or boxes. It rests on a table, not a wall.
generation_contract.pose_guard_prompt: Render one object, centered and stable on a flat neutral surface against a seamless light-gray background. Near-frontal view at screen-centre height, only 15 degrees to one side and 5 degrees above: show the blank screen, full grille, and one narrow side edge. The complete object fits with a clear margin. Even studio lighting and one soft shadow beneath. Neutral reconstruction reference, not an advertisement.
